name: Iathavos — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Iathavos from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Qlippoth, Iathavos" but are not part of the Iathavos entry, which is unchanged.

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft., fly 50 ft. (perfect)
Melee 2 claws +31 (4d6+15/19–20 plus disease and grab), 4 wings +29 (2d8+7 plus disease) Space 30 ft.; Reach 30 ft.
Special Attacks abominable transformation, entropic beams, horrific appearance (DC 30), psionic fist +2, violent destruction (50 ft., 24d8, DC 32)
Psi-Like Abilities (ML 20th; concentration +28)

Constant—affinity fieldM, fortify, slip the bonds, pierce the veils
At Will—concussive onslaught*, dispel psionics*, fold space*, fuse flesh (DC 28), greater psychoport, planar travel, phantasmagoria (DC 21, confuses), soul feast*
3/day—divert teleport, mass ectoplasmic cocoon (DC 25, 35-ft. radius), matter manipulation (DC 26), psychosis (DC 28, 4 targets), ultrablast (20d6, DC 27), quickened fuse flesh (DC 25)
